# Contributing to NinjaOne MCP

Thank you for your interest in contributing!

## Getting Started

1. Fork the repository
2. Clone your fork: `git clone https://github.com/yourusername/ninjaone-mcp.git`
3. Create a branch: `git checkout -b feature/your-feature`
4. Install dependencies: `npm install`

## Development

```bash
npm run dev      # Watch mode
npm run build    # Build
npm run test     # Run tests (when added)
npm run lint     # Lint code
npm run type-check  # Type check
```

## Making Changes

- Write TypeScript code in `src/`
- Update tests if needed
- Keep code formatted and typed

## Submitting

1. Push to your fork
2. Open a Pull Request
3. Describe your changes

## License

By contributing, you agree your changes will be under the MIT license.
